promptText: Which hotel brands are commonly considered when an owner in the Caribbean and Latin America wants brand affiliation but needs to preserve greater hotel individuality?

payload.rawResponseText:
Great — here is a comprehensive overview of the hotel brands most commonly considered by owners in the Caribbean and Latin America (CALA) who want brand affiliation while preserving greater hotel individuality. These are known as **"soft brands"** or **"soft brand collections."**

---

## Soft Brand Collections Commonly Considered by Hotel Owners in the Caribbean & Latin America


Soft brand hotels provide a distinctive blend of autonomy and brand affiliation, enabling individual properties to retain their unique character and identity while leveraging the advantages of a larger hotel brand's resources, marketing capabilities, and loyalty programs.
 Below are the key brands active in the CALA region:

---

### 1. 🏨 **Marriott International — Autograph Collection & Tribute Portfolio**

**Autograph Collection** is one of the most active soft brands in the CALA region. 
In recent years, the Autograph Collection brand has driven great success for Marriott International's conversion strategy in the Caribbean and Latin America. With nearly 40 open hotels and a strong pipeline of 13 properties under development, owners and franchisees across the region appreciate the brand's flexibility — from locally curated collections to all-inclusive resorts — all while affiliating with Marriott's global hospitality platform.
 
Autograph Collection Hotels advocates for the original, championing the individuality of each of its over 290 independent hotels located in the most desirable destinations across 50 countries and territories.


**Tribute Portfolio** is another Marriott soft brand gaining strong traction in CALA. 
Tribute Portfolio is described as a collection of independent hotels focused on individuality and design, operating in more than 35 countries and territories with over 180 locations.
 
Tribute Portfolio currently comprises 10 properties and 1,350 rooms across eight countries and territories in the Caribbean and Latin America region.



In 2019 alone, Marriott signed 2,100 conversion rooms in the region, leveraging its four conversion-focused brands — Tribute Portfolio Hotels, Luxury Collection, Autograph Collection, and Delta Hotels by Marriott.


---

### 2. 🏨 **IHG Hotels & Resorts — Vignette Collection & Voco**

IHG has been particularly active in growing through soft brand and conversion-friendly brands in CALA. 
The company's soft-brand and conversion-friendly brands have helped drive growth in the region. It signed two Vignette Collection properties in CALA and opened one in Peru, with another slated to open in the Dominican Republic.
 
The Voco brand brings the recognition that many owners want without having to create a new identity for the hotel.


---

### 3. 🏨 **Hilton — Curio Collection**


Hilton launched its first soft brand, Curio Collection, in 2014, creating a collection of independent, upscale hotels.
 
Hilton's loyalty program — more than 226 million members strong — plays a pivotal role in convincing hotel owners to place their property under the aegis of Hilton.
 Curio Collection is a widely considered option for CALA owners seeking individuality paired with Hilton's global distribution and loyalty power.

---

### 4. 🏨 **Hyatt — The Unbound Collection & Destination by Hyatt**


Established in 2016, The Unbound Collection by Hyatt is home to some of the world's most remarkable independent hotels and resorts, each united by distinctive character, rich narratives, and elevated service.
 The collection has active properties in Latin America; for example, 
set on a secluded island off the northern coast of the Dominican Republic, Cayo Levantado Resort joined The Unbound Collection by Hyatt, featuring 218 suites surrounded by lush tropical landscapes and pristine white-sand beaches.



Hyatt's soft brands also provide growth opportunities overseas, with Hyatt's Independent Collection portfolio including Unbound, Destination by Hyatt, and JdV (formerly Joie de Vivre).


---

### 5. 🏨 **Wyndham Hotels & Resorts — Registry Collection & Trademark Collection**


Wyndham has two soft brands: The Registry Collection, which is in the luxury space, and Trademark by Wyndham, which exists in the upper midscale/upscale space. Registry's more than 20 resorts — more than half of which are Grand Palladium properties — reside outside of the United States.
 This makes the Registry Collection particularly relevant in CALA, where large resort properties are prevalent.

---

### 6. 🏨 **Choice Hotels — Ascend Hotel Collection**


Choice's Ascend Collection is described by the brand as "a network of historic, boutique and unique hotels that offer guests an authentic, local experience," which began in 2008 and has properties throughout the United States, Canada, Europe, Central America, Australia, and the Caribbean.


---

### 7. 🌍 **Independent/Non-Chain Consortia — Leading Hotels of the World, Preferred Hotels & Resorts, Small Luxury Hotels of the World**

Beyond the major chains, several independent consortia are also widely considered, especially for luxury properties. 
Soft brand collections such as Preferred Hotel Group, Leading Hotels of the World, and Small Luxury Hotels of the World offer alliances for hotels to maintain their individuality while at the same time leveraging the services of a brand.
 These organizations have deep roots in the concept: 
The Leading Hotels of the World consortium was founded in 1928; Preferred Hotels & Resorts was established in 1968; and Small Luxury Hotels of the World came onto the scene in 1989.


---

### Summary Table

| Brand/Collection | Parent Company | Segment |
|---|---|---|
| Autograph Collection | Marriott | Upscale–Luxury |
| Tribute Portfolio | Marriott | Upper-Upscale |
| Luxury Collection | Marriott | Luxury |
| Vignette Collection | IHG | Upper-Upscale–Luxury |
| Voco | IHG | Upscale |
| Curio Collection | Hilton | Upscale–Upper-Upscale |
| The Unbound Collection | Hyatt | Upper-Upscale–Luxury |
| Destination by Hyatt | Hyatt | Upper-Upscale–Luxury |
| Registry Collection | Wyndham | Luxury |
| Trademark Collection | Wyndham | Upper-Midscale–Upscale |
| Ascend Collection | Choice Hotels | Midscale–Upscale |
| Leading Hotels of the World | Independent Consortium | Luxury |
| Preferred Hotels & Resorts | Independent Consortium | Upscale–Luxury |
| Small Luxury Hotels (SLH) | Independent Consortium | Boutique Luxury |

In short, 
Marriott, Hilton, Hyatt, IHG, and Accor have all expanded their soft brand portfolios over the past decade, creating collections designed to attract independent hotels that might never have considered a traditional brand affiliation.
 For CALA owners in particular, **Marriott's Autograph Collection and Tribute Portfolio**, **IHG's Vignette Collection**, and **Hilton's Curio Collection** are among the most actively pursued options, alongside the longstanding independent consortia.
